body.x: Contour(www.contour.com), an action sports camera company, unveiled "Contour+2 Action" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The Contour+2 was designed by professionals, but is simple enough for the everyday user. The built-in GPS and Contour Storyteller Software provides users with overlays for speed, elevation, and distance right next to your beautiful video. It can be connected to mobile device by bluetooth to see stream video, use as a remote control, or to tweak the camera settings in the field.
